scope: Clarifications before any reference or experimental model call; numeric budgets and stimuli unchanged
candidate_selection: Use last schema-valid, boundary-valid and compile-valid candidate by fixed round order; never select using hidden scores. Retain every attempt and mark a session invalid if none qualifies. Development false alarms do not invalidate or remove a candidate from evaluation.
cross_simulator_policy: Original strict all-field comparison of preflight-v2 retained as failed. Subsequent audit distinguishes binary contradictions from X-versus-concrete differences. All correct-control defined observations must match. Mutant X-sensitive pairs remain visible; two-state primary scores and Icarus unknown statuses reported separately.
development_denominator_encoding: Lossless shared column dictionary; all 400 raw counter identities and all per-trace hits retained. No coverage location merged by eclass.
final_scoring_release: All B-prime/C-prime final candidate source and metadata hashes must be committed to a release manifest before any candidate sees a final trajectory. Fixed held-out inputs may be examined by offline reference calibration beforehand to determine observability, never by candidate authors.
formal_schedule: After final candidate freeze only: bmc/prove/cover on both correct implementations; bmc on each of six mutants. Same fixed schedule per valid candidate. Preserve timeout/unknown/error; invalid candidates recorded rather than removed. No extra search or retries based on arm.
formal_vacuity: Report cover outcomes for all six active signals. Activation alone does not demonstrate usefulness; tautological properties require actual independent fault detections to earn ROI.
heldout_publication: Local private-directory membership is prompt-access isolation, not encryption. Do not publish held-out control sources/traces until all candidate artifacts have frozen. Preserve artifacts for reproducibility afterwards.
phase1_gate: Registration and offline plumbing do not authorize a live model-generation run; independent reference review, fault-observability freeze, runner accounting tests and a new live-freeze artifact are still required.
